> EPM DEVTECH is a Brazilian software house specialized in custom software development, scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, system architecture, and high-performance web solutions. Founded and led by Elessandro Prestes Macedo, a senior full-stack engineer with 9+ years of experience.

## Services

- Custom software development (web systems, SPAs, PWAs)
- Scalable REST and GraphQL APIs
- Software architecture (hexagonal, microservices, modular monolith)
- System integration (ERP, CRM, third-party APIs)
- Technical consulting and code review
- CI/CD pipeline setup and DevOps

## Sectors of expertise

- Industry and manufacturing (ERP, production automation)
- E-commerce and retail (checkout, inventory, scaling)
- Education (CAPES/MEC government projects)
- Energy (ONS — Brazilian grid operator, mission-critical systems)

## Tech stack

Backend: PHP, Laravel, Symfony, Node.js, TypeScript
Frontend: React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis
Cloud: AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes
Messaging: RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, SonarQube
